subject: Copywriting
title: Digital Luxury and the Metaverse
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Digital Luxury and the Metaverse.

hook.text: Gucci sold a virtual bag on Roblox for $4,115—more than the real version.

buildup.text: Luxury brands are minting NFTs, creating virtual fashion, and building metaverse boutiques.

discovery.text: Digital luxury copy shifts from sensory language ('hand-stitched calfskin') to experiential ('exclusive access').

twist.text: The NFT luxury bubble burst in 2023. Most digital luxury items lost value.

climax.text: Digital luxury's copywriting challenge: creating perceived permanence for inherently ephemeral products.

punchline.text: A virtual bag costs more than a real one. Luxury copy now sells the intangible.

quiz.question: How much did a virtual Gucci bag sell for on Roblox?
